answer: Written in a skeptical lens, addresses failure modes first register, it stays short. Every claim climbs the mesa of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the river re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Reaching the orchard of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on cryptographic attestation with threshold signatures.
